correctness.rationale: Directly from open-neighborhood trace definitions, an LD-set of K_{m,n}, m,n≥2, omits at most one vertex per shore, giving gamma_L=m+n-2. For K_{1,n} (n≥2), gamma_L=n. The explicit partition V\{y1,y2}, {y1}, {y2} with y1,y2 in a shore of size ≥3 supplies three coalition blocks; P3 uses all singleton blocks. K2,2 has four singleton coalition blocks and the general bound n-gamma_L+2≤4. For any hypothetical four-block partition of a larger biclique, two coalition partners cover all but exactly one vertex on each shore, hence the other two blocks are opposite-shore singletons; analyzing their required partners forces an LD two-vertex set and therefore m=n=2, contradiction. K2 has none because each singleton is already LD. An independent complete set-partition enumeration for all m≤n,total vertices≤8 confirmed 16 small profiles; this corroborates the all-size structural proof.
residual_risks: The claim uses ordinary locating-dominating coalitions, not locating-total, solid-locating or other similarly named invariants.
